headline: Maya reaches the real app gate knowing the three-step workflow, available models, export formats, and credit model she is evaluating.
overview: A live product-level walk for AutoBounds, framed around Maya Thornton's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
payoff: Maya reaches the real app gate knowing the three-step workflow, available models, export formats, and credit model she is evaluating.

scenes.title: The outcome is stated before the machinery
scenes.narrative: The promise is concrete: turn manual delineation into an export-ready starting point from satellite imagery.
frameCaptions: The outcome is stated before the machinery
scenes.action: Opened the public AutoBounds product page.

scenes.title: The workflow is point, process, export
scenes.narrative: Maya can see what she must provide, what the model does, and what leaves the system before she evaluates implementation detail.
frameCaptions: The workflow is point, process, export

scenes.title: Models are compared by operating trade-offs
scenes.narrative: The model page makes speed, prompting, and boundary quality part of the product decision instead of presenting AI as one opaque button.
frameCaptions: Models are compared by operating trade-offs

scenes.title: Credits map to accepted work
scenes.narrative: Pricing explains that one credit buys one extraction and is deducted only when a result is accepted, which is the operational unit Maya needed.

scenes.title: The real application starts at an account gate
scenes.narrative: The walkthrough stops honestly at the production sign-in surface; projects, Labs, and exports remain blocked without an authenticated workspace.
frameCaptions: The real application starts at an account gate
scenes.action: Opened the production app demo route.
